newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SANITAS POSTS H1 97 4 MLN LITAS NET PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: SANITAS POSTS H1 97 4 MLN LITAS NET PROFIT.

text.p: Lithuania's biggest pharmaceutical producer Sanitas said on Monday that its net profit for the first half of the year was four million litas but would not give comparative figures.
Company director general Albertas Bertulis also told Reuters that the company's pre-tax profit in the first six months of the year was 5.8 million litas.
He also said that production output was 25.3 million litas in the first half compared to 24.3 million litas in the same period last year.
Sales of the firm also rose to 23.4 million litas during the first six months of the year from 22.7 million litas in the same period in 1996, Bertulis said.
The company reported net profit of 10.74 million litas and sales of almost 42 million litas in 1996.
Sanitas said earlier that it had been hit earlier after the government cancelled a five percent profit tax priveledge for the compant and imposed the usual 29 percent tax rate.
The company exported 85 percent of its products, mainly to Russia, during the first half of the year Bertulis said.
"We sucessfully expanded our markets to Kazakhstan, Armenia, Belarus, Uzbekistan and Azerbaijan by registering a higher variety of medicines in those countries," Bertulis said.
He also said that Sanitas will start secondary packing of medicine received from Glaxo Wellcome in the coming autumn.
"At the beginning it will be one sort of medicine," Bertulis added.
